title: os migrate meta prints tracker numbers to the author: ADR-0087 migration entries' reason / replacement / acceptanceCriteria text carries ~2,060 of them, 178 dead, which AGENTS.md's runtime-string rule forbids
body:
Filing gate ①, finding class (b): a named producer prints text to the author that breaks a stated rule, and the gate that owns the rule does not read those positions. Found by the #19123 dev round (PR #20226, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 4 (`session_01CiCTczDo7tGhafXjf61dUJ`, seat post #18917). ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## The rule

`AGENTS.md` (`origin/main` `93cfc3f59`, lines 16–18): 「Runtime strings — refusal prose, prescriptions, anything an author is shown — carry no tracker number (`pnpm check:doc-authoring`): the lesson goes into the text.」

## The producer, read by this seat

`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.ts` (about :519–526 on `93cfc3f59`) prints each semantic TODO to the author:

```
⚠ [protocol N] surface → ${t.replacement}
    why:    ${t.reason}
    verify: ${t.acceptanceCriteria}
```

The three fields come from the ADR-0087 semantic entries under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/**`. So their text is 「anything an author is shown」.

## The measurement

- The #19123 dev round, relayed (⛔ this seat did not re-run the REST probe): across `packages/spec/src/migrations/**`, those positions hold **2,060 tracker-id sites (478 distinct numbers)**. **178** of those sites cite numbers that answer **404** today (deleted, not moved: the census found 0 answering 301). PR #20226's body carries the census method and its controls.
- This seat's own corroboration, at `93cfc3f59`: `git grep -c -E '#[0-9]{4,5}\b'` over `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/**` counts **1,529 lines in 590 files**. That count is line-level and wider than the three positions, so it is an upper bound, not the same instrument.
- `pnpm check:doc-authoring` exits 0 over all of them. Rule 3 does not recognise the `reason` / `replacement` / `acceptanceCriteria` positions, and Rule 3b excludes `packages/spec/src`.

## Why it matters

An operator running `os migrate meta` on a real project reads 「why:」 and 「verify:」 lines that send them to tracker numbers. Some of those numbers no longer exist (178 sites), and the rest can disappear in turn: #19123 measured an 11.7–15.1% one-week decay. The lesson each entry exists to teach is then behind a link instead of in the text the author is reading.

## Routing notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The sibling gate-reach card #19124 (the same gate, blind to `packages/spec/scripts/**`) was closed `not_planned` under the tooling stock cleanup (ruling #202 B, #19458). So ⛔ this card is not filed as a request to widen the gate. The defect is the author-facing text itself.
- The fix lands in `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/**` (the `domain:spec` ledger). At about 2,060 sites it is a sweep; staging and whether the gate's reach moves with it are triage's and the lane's call.
- Ruling C+D on #19123 (`5749154545`) already sets the form: D for anything an author is shown, i.e. the lesson in words, no number.

## Dedupe

`mcp__github__search_issues` (repo-scoped, semantic, closed included): `doc-authoring migration entry reason replacement tracker number` → 4 hits, 0 duplicates (#12996, #7753, #7491, #6967: other gates or other text). #19124 is the nearest relative (the same gate, a different path, closed `not_planned`).

Dedupe words: `migrate meta why verify tracker number` · `migration entry reason tracker id` · `doc-authoring Rule 3 migration reason position` · `os migrate meta issue number printed` · `runtime string tracker id migrations`
